text:
owen: Heads up — noticed prod nodepool with GPU count 0 after last gitops apply. Staging is fine. Apps hitting OOMs. Anyone saw this? :eyes:

drftbot: Automated drift watcher: detected config difference in helmrelease/redwood-gpu-pool between prod and git (values.gpu.count: prod=0 git=8). Link: https://git.company/repo/changes/123

maria: checking gitops diff now. running `git --no-pager diff origin/main...prod -- charts/gpu/values.yaml`

maria: hmm looks like last PR (174) had implicit merge that set gpu.count to 0 for region eu-west due to env var interpolation bug

priya: that change was intended as temporary for spot testing but should've been scoped to branch. I'm on it.

alex: priority — customers hitting increased latency on small-queue batch workloads. Can we patch prod to 8 while we fix process?

owen: +1. Plan: (1) dry-run helm upgrade with values override, (2) roll patch via gitops by creating revert PR, (3) monitor autoscaler. Any objections?

priya: OK. I'll run dry-run first. Command:
```
helm upgrade redwood-gpu-pool charts/gpu --namespace infra --set values.gpu.count=8 --dry-run
```

maria: FYI the reconciler is paused for 12m windows in prod; we might need to trigger immediate reconcile: `kubectl annotate helmrelease/reconciler-controller fluxcd.io/reconcileAt="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"`

driftbot: Note: reconcile paused flag detected in prod due to 'maintenance-window' tag.

priya: unpause done, starting dry-run now.

owen: after dry-run success, open PR to revert the spot-test change and include explicit env guard

maria: opened PR https://git.company/repo/pull/567 — includes guard `if env == 'staging'` for spot-testing

alex: also add a policy check in CI to block gpu.count=0 in prod values. else we'll repeat this.

priya: adding a tfvars Helm values validation step to CI linter, will push in 10m.

owen: can someone watch node provisioning? I'll run `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia --watch` and share results.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: helm release redwood-gpu-pool dry-run OK. No errors.

maria: reconcile kicked, nodes provisioning started. current nodes: 2 -> provisioning 4 -> expected 8.

owen: great. Keep an eye on spot fallback. If spot pools can't fill, autoscaler will fallback to on-demand; cost impact ~+$0.6/hr/node

alex: file a quick postmortem note in incidents channel after incident. Add root cause: merge scoping + missing CI guard + reconciler paused window.

priya: done. Will follow-up with CI PR and a small alert to ops slack if gpu.count changes by >2.

owen: thanks all :thumbsup:
